scope.summary: Implement cursor-chat and spotlight/follow facilitation as projections of the collaboration substrate: a transient chat bubble attached to a live cursor for lightweight in-canvas messaging (over 14.17 live cursors); and spotlight/follow where a presenter pulls all participants' viewports along with their navigation until spotlight ends (over 14.17 presence/viewport). Non-intrusive per the quiet law.
expected_tests: live: cursor-chat bubble appears on a live cursor across sessions
live: spotlight pulls follower viewport until ended
negative: spotlight does not focus-steal an operator in a different project/module
acceptance_criteria_original: cursor chat + spotlight/follow over 14.17 presence; non-intrusive across scopes

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-WB-007] Studio MUST provide session **facilitation** as a projection of the collaboration substrate (14.17), not as whiteboard-private machinery. The facilitation set below reuses cursors, presence, and comments from 14.17. | Facilitation feature | Behavior | Backing | |---|---|---| | Voting session | Facilitator opens a session; participants place a limited number of (optionally anonymous) votes on objects, with reveal and tally at end | 14.17 collaboration + `StudioLayer` vote targets | | Timer | Shared countdown timer visible to all participants, with optional audio, for timed exercises | 14.17 session state | | Cursor chat | Transient chat bubble attached to a live cursor for lightweight in-canvas messaging | 14.17 live cursors | | Spotlight / follow | A presenter pulls all participants' viewports along with their navigation until spotlight ends | 14.17 presence/viewport |

[STU-QUIET-003] NON-INTRUSIVE CO-WORK. While the operator uses Studio (or any other Handshake module) on a project/module, agent work on a different project/module MUST NOT bring Studio to the foreground, pop panes, move the operator's viewport, or change the operator's active tool/selection. Agent activity in the operator's current file is surfaced through presence/pending-proposal indicators (14.21), never through intrusive UI takeover.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
